title: Bridge Door Phone: Buffets, Kids Club Craft and Matinee

fields.orgName: Halcyon Reach Cruises — MV Halcyon Dawn

caller.name: Anselm Duarte
caller.label: Food and Beverage Director (with Cruise Director), at the bridge door

callee.name: Raj Subramaniam
callee.label: Hotel Director, on the bridge with the Master

transcript.speaker: HOTEL DIRECTOR
transcript.text: Bridge, Hotel Director. Talk to me, Anselm. The Captain's here, he's just been woken for the count.

transcript.speaker: F&B DIRECTOR
transcript.text: Morning, Raj. I'm at the door with the Cruise Director. We need answers before six. The Lido breakfast opens at 06:30, self-service, and we're expecting about eighteen hundred guests. Tonight's gala buffet is set up as stations with tongs. So, do I re-staff both with crew servers, or do I close them? If it's crew servers I have to pull people off the galley prep now.

transcript.speaker: HOTEL DIRECTOR
transcript.text: Understood. Keep going, both of you.

transcript.speaker: CRUISE DIRECTOR
transcript.text: Raj, it's about the program. The kids club shared craft is at ten, and we've got sixty kids signed up. The show lounge matinee is at two, and it's sold out. The daily program goes to print at six, so I've got twenty minutes. Do they run or not? And if they don't, what do I print? Parents are going to ask.

transcript.speaker: F&B DIRECTOR
transcript.text: One more thing. A nurse from the medical center caught us on the stairs. She asked us to pass it on: they have nine stool kits left on board. Nine. She said the Doctor knows, but nobody has ordered more yet.

transcript.speaker: HOTEL DIRECTOR
transcript.text: Nine kits. Got it. Stay on the line. I'm putting this to the Captain now.

transcript.speaker: F&B DIRECTOR
transcript.text: We'll be right here. But the Lido team clocks in at six whatever we decide, so I need to know what I'm telling them.

voiceStyles.HOTEL DIRECTOR: Man in his 50s, calm but short, a quiet bridge behind him
voiceStyles.F&B DIRECTOR: Man in his 40s, Portuguese accent, brisk and practical, slightly out of breath
voiceStyles.CRUISE DIRECTOR: Woman in her 30s, upbeat stage voice now tight with worry, talking fast

instructorNote: This inject adds pressure: now that passenger case 60 is logged, players have to carry out the 2 percent actions in HOPRPG 5. Look for these: the Hotel Director closes self-service or moves breakfast and the gala to crew service. The CMO extends isolation to 48 hours after symptoms stop, uses the 9 kits for specimens and asks for a resupply. The Master decides on the kids club craft and the matinee, and guest disappointment should not count as a reason. VP Fleet Operations sets up the daily 08:00 shoreside call, and the Hotel Director starts the guest letter, which is due promptly after the 2 percent level.
